prompts.F1-K4a: Wide eye-level shot of a cozy neighbourhood barbershop in Brazil, warm late-afternoon natural light through the window, vintage mirrors, plants, a green waiting bench along the wall. Samuel, the barber, is a white Brazilian man in his mid-30s with fair skin, short dark brown hair and a well-groomed beard, wearing a plain dark green shirt; standing behind the barber chair in the centre of the frame, he runs the clippers over a client's hair while they chat. The client, seated under a plain dark green barber cape with no print, laughs genuinely, happy and relaxed. On the waiting bench to the right, a woman smiles proudly at her husband in the chair, and another client waits casually. Main action centred in the frame.
prompts.F1-K4: Edit this photo: remove the word written on the green barber cape so the cape is plain dark green fabric with no letters, logos or print. Keep everything else exactly identical: same people, faces, expressions, poses, clothing, lighting, colours, background and framing.
